data.body:
[P2] Handle delete-start failures per stack

A failed `delete-stack` call throws from `execFileSync` outside any catch, aborting cleanup before later stacks are processed or the waiter loop runs. This can occur when a PR closes during a CloudFormation update: `LIVE_STATUSES` includes `UPDATE_IN_PROGRESS`, and cleanup runs independently of deployment. Catch and collect failures when starting each deletion, continue processing the other stacks, and report the aggregate failure after waiting for successfully started deletions.
